title: Targeted Comment Engagement Round
description: Scout top posts in the client's niche hashtags, draft one tailored comment per post, validate for quality and safety, then post 10–12 genuine value comments from the client's account.

inputs.label: Brand voice in one line (e.g. friendly expert, playful)

nodes.title: Scout posts and draft tailored comments
nodes.detail: Using the client's logged-in account, browse each hashtag's recent and top posts and select 12 posts with active comment sections that fit the client's niche. Actually read each post and draft one tailored comment that responds to its specific content. Rules: no copy-paste phrasing, no emoji walls, no overt promotion, no links — only value comments (a question, genuine take, or added tip) that reference the post itself.
nodes.acceptance: 12 posts prepared with URL, gist, and a tailored comment draft each.

subtasks.title: Read each post's content
subtasks.purpose: The gist that grounds a tailored comment

subtasks.title: Draft tailored comments
subtasks.purpose: Unique per post, in the brand voice

nodes.title: Verify comment drafts are safe
nodes.detail: Check that targets has 10+ entries, no two draft comments share phrasing (copy-paste detection), none contain promotion, links, or emoji walls, and each comment actually references its post's gist.

nodes.title: Post 10–12 comments and report
nodes.detail: Post the validated drafts in order: open each post, leave its comment, and pace the round naturally — never exceeding 12 comments. Skip failures (restricted comments, deleted posts) with the reason recorded; do not retry aggressively. Finish by reporting the posted list (post URL + comment) and the skipped list.
nodes.acceptance: 10+ comments posted; full posted and skipped lists reported.

subtasks.title: Handle failures gracefully
subtasks.purpose: Skip with reason, no retry spam
